resists.volcanic-shaman: Cap fire and necrotic. Almost all of the harm is those two.
resists.emperor-of-corpses: Cap necrotic first, and physical as well. Those are the main types.
resists.frost-lich-formosus: Cap cold, necrotic, and lightning. The adds bring most of the lightning.
resists.god-hunter-argentus: Cap fire and cold. Those two make up most of the fight.
resists.hartons-husk: Cap void first, and physical as well.
resists.heorot-monolith: Cap cold first, and physical as well.
resists.rahyeh-the-black-sun: Cap void. The fight is void damage only.
resists.husk-of-elder-gaspar: Cap void, fire, cold, and lightning. Heavy hits use all four.
resists.lagon-campaign: Cap cold and lightning first, and physical too.
resists.majasa-phase-1: Cap physical first. It is the highest priority for the whole fight. This phase also uses fire, lightning, and poison.
resists.majasa-phase-2: Cap physical. This phase is physical only, and that is the priority.
resists.aberroth: Cap void and physical. Those are the defenses this fight asks for.
resists.herald-of-oblivion: Cap void and physical. Those are the defenses this fight asks for.
resists.vision-of-the-observer: Cap void before the other types. That is the main defense here.
resists.shade-of-orobyss: Always cap void. Skip necrotic. The other types depend on which variant you roll.

harbinger-defilement-slam.spot: A tight floor strike lands, then a ring travels away from him.
harbinger-defilement-slam.avoid: Step off the impact, and do not linger where the ring is spreading.

harbinger-defilement-massive-slam.spot: He strikes a wide area of the floor.
harbinger-defilement-massive-slam.avoid: Get outside the wide patch before the slam connects.

harbinger-defilement-echo-slam.spot: He and five echoes hit the same place in a row. Lines travel out from each echo.
harbinger-defilement-echo-slam.avoid: Do not stand where those slams overlap. The lines leave each echo.

harbinger-defilement-void-combo-strike.spot: Three cuts come first. The ground slam after them is the heavy part.
harbinger-defilement-void-combo-strike.avoid: You can meet a cut. Be clear before the closing slam.

harbinger-defilement-void-orbs.spot: Several orbs sit on the floor for a short time.
harbinger-defilement-void-orbs.avoid: They hit only if you walk on them. Path around the patches.

harbinger-defilement-void-portal-blast.spot: A gate opens beside him. After a short timer he thrusts the hammer through it.
harbinger-defilement-void-portal-blast.avoid: Leave the space in front of that gate before the delayed thrust.

harbinger-defilement-void-rush.spot: He rushes toward you and strikes the space in front of him.
harbinger-defilement-void-rush.avoid: Sidestep the path of the rush so the front hit misses.

harbinger-defilement-void-strike.spot: He swings forward and sends a short wave.
harbinger-defilement-void-strike.avoid: A side step takes you off that narrow wave.

harbinger-defilement-void-turrets.spot: Orbs on the floor shoot one direction for several seconds.
harbinger-defilement-void-turrets.avoid: Stand off the line each orb is firing.

harbinger-defilement-spirit-decay.spot: A large pool spreads on the ground.
harbinger-defilement-spirit-decay.avoid: Leave the necrotic pool. Standing in it is a heavy hit.

harbinger-defilement-tail-flare.spot: A very large slam area is shown, then shockwaves are shown after it.
harbinger-defilement-tail-flare.avoid: Exit the first slam and the shockwaves. Both are marked before they hit.

harbinger-pride-portal-spear.spot: One gate is beside her and one is near you. The spear comes out of the far gate after a delay.
harbinger-pride-portal-spear.avoid: Step off the portal near you before the spear arrives there.

harbinger-pride-spear-beam.spot: She charges, then a fire beam runs both in front of her and behind her.
harbinger-pride-spear-beam.avoid: Step off the front line and the back line. The beam uses both.

harbinger-pride-spear-dash.spot: She dashes at you with the spear drawn.
harbinger-pride-spear-dash.avoid: At range, slide off the dash. Up close the hit is light if you cannot.

harbinger-pride-spear-thrust.spot: Two fast cuts come while she slides forward.
harbinger-pride-spear-thrust.avoid: Step off the slide. Both swings ride that movement.

harbinger-pride-void-blast.spot: Several orbs rest on the ground for a brief time.
harbinger-pride-void-blast.avoid: Walk around the orbs. Stepping on one is the hit.

harbinger-pride-void-slam.spot: She rises, then drops on a marked patch.
harbinger-pride-void-slam.avoid: Exit the marked landing before she comes down.

harbinger-pride-void-slash.spot: She spins into a slash, and a wave travels away from her.
harbinger-pride-void-slash.avoid: Clear the spin and the wave that keeps going outward.

harbinger-pride-void-spears.spot: Two spears sit on the ground, then burst into shots. They also apply frailty and armor shred.
harbinger-pride-void-spears.avoid: Move away before the spears burst.

harbinger-pride-turrets.spot: Turrets aim at you, follow briefly, then lock a spot. No damage type is stated.
harbinger-pride-turrets.avoid: Strafe until they lock. These turrets can be destroyed, so break them between mechanics.

harbinger-pride-fire-bomb.spot: A spiral of circles starts on her and explodes outward.
harbinger-pride-fire-bomb.avoid: Move out of the spiral when you can. It is a moderate fire hit.

harbinger-hatred-slam.spot: The first hit is small. A follow-up ring moves outward from the boss.
harbinger-hatred-slam.avoid: Leave that small patch before the outward ring reaches you.

harbinger-hatred-massive-slam.spot: The marked area for this slam is large.
harbinger-hatred-massive-slam.avoid: Give the broad floor hit a full step of room.

harbinger-hatred-echo-slam.spot: Five echoes join his slam on one shared point, then damage runs outward.
harbinger-hatred-echo-slam.avoid: The shared middle is where several hits stack. Stand off that point.

harbinger-hatred-void-combo-strike.spot: He slashes three times, then brings the weapon down.
harbinger-hatred-void-combo-strike.avoid: The last slam is the hard hit. Step out before it lands.

harbinger-hatred-void-orbs.spot: Orbs appear underfoot and linger briefly.
harbinger-hatred-void-orbs.avoid: Route past each orb until it fades.

harbinger-hatred-void-portal-blast.spot: The portal shows up next to him, then the hammer comes through.
harbinger-hatred-void-portal-blast.avoid: Use the pause after the gate appears to step off its line.

harbinger-hatred-void-rush.spot: The charge ends in a swing ahead of his body.
harbinger-hatred-void-rush.avoid: Be beside the rush, not on the line he is running.

harbinger-hatred-void-strike.spot: The wave is small and travels straight out from him.
harbinger-hatred-void-strike.avoid: Do not stand on the short wave he sends ahead.

harbinger-hatred-void-turrets.spot: Each placed orb fires a single way until it stops.
harbinger-hatred-void-turrets.avoid: Step to either side of that shot.

harbinger-hatred-void-slam.spot: He marks a large area in front of him. There is a short delay before it hits.
harbinger-hatred-void-slam.avoid: Use that delay to leave the marked area.

harbinger-hatred-void-skyfall.spot: Meteor-like shots fall over several seconds.
harbinger-hatred-void-skyfall.avoid: Stay out of them. Two at once add up.

harbinger-hatred-void-flares.spot: He channels cones in a pie from the center, moving clockwise. He does not have to stay in the middle.
harbinger-hatred-void-flares.avoid: Shift with the rotation. The edge is a harder place to stand than it looks.

harbinger-war-portal-spear.spot: Two portals open, and the thrust travels from hers into the one by you.
harbinger-war-portal-spear.avoid: The exit portal is the danger. Be off it when the spear comes through.

harbinger-war-spear-beam.spot: After the charge, the fire shot is not only forward.
harbinger-war-spear-beam.avoid: Leave the line ahead of her and the line behind her.

harbinger-war-spear-dash.spot: The spear dash comes straight at you.
harbinger-war-spear-dash.avoid: Sidestep when you have room. The damage is the smaller hit.

harbinger-war-spear-thrust.spot: She moves toward you and attacks twice in a row.
harbinger-war-spear-thrust.avoid: Give the forward slide a side step.

harbinger-war-void-blast.spot: Short-lived floor orbs are the whole attack.
harbinger-war-void-blast.avoid: Keep your path off those orbs until they expire.

harbinger-war-void-slam.spot: The landing spot is shown while she is in the air.
harbinger-war-void-slam.avoid: Be outside that mark when she lands.

harbinger-war-void-slash.spot: Both the slash and the blast wave that leaves her are hits.
harbinger-war-void-slash.avoid: Step off her and off the path the wave takes.

harbinger-war-void-spears.spot: The ground spears explode into projectiles after a few seconds.
harbinger-war-void-spears.avoid: Leave them before the pop, or you take frailty and armor shred.

harbinger-war-ice-vortex.spot: Slow cold storms wander at random and keep getting stronger.
harbinger-war-ice-vortex.avoid: Stay outside them. They move slowly, so you can keep clear.

harbinger-war-spirit-beam.spot: A thick beam sits in front of him and widens the longer the channel lasts.
harbinger-war-spirit-beam.avoid: The beam is shown in front of him. Leave that line.

harbinger-chaos-portal-spear.spot: A short delay separates the portals from the spear shot.
harbinger-chaos-portal-spear.avoid: Watch the gate closest to you and leave that spot before the thrust.

harbinger-chaos-spear-beam.spot: The beam fires along her facing, front and rear together.
harbinger-chaos-spear-beam.avoid: Get off both sides of that line before it fires.

harbinger-chaos-spear-dash.spot: She closes with the spear out.
harbinger-chaos-spear-dash.avoid: Stay off her dash path if you can. In melee there is little time, and the hit is light.

harbinger-chaos-spear-thrust.spot: The pair of cuts travels with her approach.
harbinger-chaos-spear-thrust.avoid: Do not stay on the path of that slide.

harbinger-chaos-void-blast.spot: Orbs spawn underfoot and do not chase.
harbinger-chaos-void-blast.avoid: Circle around them instead of crossing the patch.

harbinger-chaos-void-slam.spot: A telegraph appears, then she slams down on it.
harbinger-chaos-void-slam.avoid: Leave the shown patch as soon as she leaves the ground.

harbinger-chaos-void-slash.spot: A quick spin sends a wave outward.
harbinger-chaos-void-slash.avoid: Do not stand in the spin or on the departing wave.

harbinger-chaos-void-spears.spot: Two void spears detonate into a spread.
harbinger-chaos-void-spears.avoid: Be elsewhere when they split. The burst shreds armor and applies frailty.

harbinger-chaos-lagonian-waves.spot: Cold waves from the Lagon fight keep coming during this harbinger.
harbinger-chaos-lagonian-waves.avoid: Dodge what you can. The hits are moderate and add up if you stand in them.

harbinger-chaos-lagonian-beam.spot: Her beam is shorter than Lagon's, less clearly shown, and it does not sweep the platform.
harbinger-chaos-lagonian-beam.avoid: Do not stand in the beam. It still burns health quickly.

harbinger-treason-portal-spear.spot: One gate is beside her and one is near you. The spear comes out of the far gate after a delay.
harbinger-treason-portal-spear.avoid: Step off the portal near you before the spear arrives there.

harbinger-treason-spear-beam.spot: She charges, then a fire beam runs both in front of her and behind her.
harbinger-treason-spear-beam.avoid: Step off the front line and the back line. The beam uses both.

harbinger-treason-spear-dash.spot: She dashes at you with the spear drawn.
harbinger-treason-spear-dash.avoid: At range, slide off the dash. Up close the hit is light if you cannot.

harbinger-treason-spear-thrust.spot: Two fast cuts come while she slides forward.
harbinger-treason-spear-thrust.avoid: Step off the slide. Both swings ride that movement.

harbinger-treason-void-blast.spot: Several orbs rest on the ground for a brief time.
harbinger-treason-void-blast.avoid: Walk around the orbs. Stepping on one is the hit.

harbinger-treason-void-slam.spot: She rises, then drops on a marked patch.
harbinger-treason-void-slam.avoid: Exit the marked landing before she comes down.

harbinger-treason-void-slash.spot: She spins into a slash, and a wave travels away from her.
harbinger-treason-void-slash.avoid: Clear the spin and the wave that keeps going outward.

harbinger-treason-void-spears.spot: Two spears sit on the ground, then burst into shots. They also apply frailty and armor shred.
harbinger-treason-void-spears.avoid: Move away before the spears burst.

harbinger-treason-idols-of-ruin.spot: Idols left alive in the Harton fight keep attacking here.
harbinger-treason-idols-of-ruin.avoid: Kill the idols during Harton so they are not still up for this fight.

harbinger-treason-void-worms.spot: Worms are summoned on a timer. No damage type is stated.
harbinger-treason-void-worms.avoid: They are a low hit with low health. Kill them when you have a moment.

harbinger-treason-void-anomaly.spot: A large circle sits on the ground for several seconds.
harbinger-treason-void-anomaly.avoid: The whole circle is the hit. Do not stand anywhere inside it.

harbinger-treason-void-starfire.spot: A star of lines forms around her and stays up for several seconds.
harbinger-treason-void-starfire.avoid: Stand in the gaps of the star so the other hits do not land on you as well.

harbinger-destruction-slam.spot: Watch for a short slam and the ring that follows it away from center.
harbinger-destruction-slam.avoid: Be off the slam itself, then keep clear of the expanding ring.

harbinger-destruction-massive-slam.spot: This is the big version of his ground strike.
harbinger-destruction-massive-slam.avoid: Stand beyond the wide impact, not inside it.

harbinger-destruction-echo-slam.spot: The echoes and the boss strike one spot, and each sends a line away.
harbinger-destruction-echo-slam.avoid: Leave the overlap. A line comes off every echo.

harbinger-destruction-void-combo-strike.spot: The combo ends in a floor strike after three swings.
harbinger-destruction-void-combo-strike.avoid: Treat the first swings as the warning and exit for the final slam.

harbinger-destruction-void-orbs.spot: Look for short-lived orbs resting on the ground.
harbinger-destruction-void-orbs.avoid: Step around the orbs instead of through them.

harbinger-destruction-void-portal-blast.spot: You will see a portal by his side before the hammer strike.
harbinger-destruction-void-portal-blast.avoid: The thrust is late. Be aside of the portal when it fires.

harbinger-destruction-void-rush.spot: He closes the gap and hits forward at the end.
harbinger-destruction-void-rush.avoid: Slide off his approach before that front strike.

harbinger-destruction-void-strike.spot: Look for a forward strike that becomes a tight wave.
harbinger-destruction-void-strike.avoid: Move to the side of the wave rather than backing along it.

harbinger-destruction-void-turrets.spot: Turret orbs lock a straight beam for a few seconds.
harbinger-destruction-void-turrets.avoid: Leave the beam's line until the orb is done.

harbinger-destruction-spirit-pools.spot: Pools from the Emperor fight stay on the arena edges for the whole fight. They take a percent of remaining health.
harbinger-destruction-spirit-pools.avoid: Stay away from the edges. They cannot finish you alone, but they remove large chunks.

harbinger-destruction-raise-dead.spot: He summons a large pack of undead.
harbinger-destruction-raise-dead.avoid: Clear the undead quickly. Each one is a low hit.

harbinger-destruction-spirit-breath.spot: A cone of necrotic damage over time comes off his front and grows while it lasts. The mark is less obvious than on the Emperor.
harbinger-destruction-spirit-breath.avoid: Stay off his front. Do not stand in the breath.

harbinger-fear-portal-spear.spot: Two portals open, and the thrust travels from hers into the one by you.
harbinger-fear-portal-spear.avoid: The exit portal is the danger. Be off it when the spear comes through.

harbinger-fear-spear-beam.spot: After the charge, the fire shot is not only forward.
harbinger-fear-spear-beam.avoid: Leave the line ahead of her and the line behind her.

harbinger-fear-spear-dash.spot: The spear dash comes straight at you.
harbinger-fear-spear-dash.avoid: Sidestep when you have room. The damage is the smaller hit.

harbinger-fear-spear-thrust.spot: She moves toward you and attacks twice in a row.
harbinger-fear-spear-thrust.avoid: Give the forward slide a side step.

harbinger-fear-void-blast.spot: Short-lived floor orbs are the whole attack.
harbinger-fear-void-blast.avoid: Keep your path off those orbs until they expire.

harbinger-fear-void-slam.spot: The landing spot is shown while she is in the air.
harbinger-fear-void-slam.avoid: Be outside that mark when she lands.

harbinger-fear-void-slash.spot: Both the slash and the blast wave that leaves her are hits.
harbinger-fear-void-slash.avoid: Step off her and off the path the wave takes.

harbinger-fear-void-spears.spot: The ground spears explode into projectiles after a few seconds.
harbinger-fear-void-spears.avoid: Leave them before the pop, or you take frailty and armor shred.

harbinger-fear-spark-discharge.spot: Stepping on a ground mine starts a short fuse, and the blast follows.
harbinger-fear-spark-discharge.avoid: Run through them on purpose to clear them, and keep moving so the blast misses.

harbinger-fear-tri-beam.spot: A center turret fires three rotating beams, one each of fire, cold, and lightning. She keeps attacking during it.
harbinger-fear-tri-beam.avoid: This page says to walk clockwise, or cross a beam with a movement skill that has an invulnerability frame.

harbinger-tyranny-slam.spot: A tight floor strike lands, then a ring travels away from him.
harbinger-tyranny-slam.avoid: Step off the impact, and do not linger where the ring is spreading.

harbinger-tyranny-massive-slam.spot: He strikes a wide area of the floor.
harbinger-tyranny-massive-slam.avoid: Get outside the wide patch before the slam connects.

harbinger-tyranny-echo-slam.spot: He and five echoes hit the same place in a row. Lines travel out from each echo.
harbinger-tyranny-echo-slam.avoid: Do not stand where those slams overlap. The lines leave each echo.

harbinger-tyranny-void-combo-strike.spot: Three cuts come first. The ground slam after them is the heavy part.
harbinger-tyranny-void-combo-strike.avoid: You can meet a cut. Be clear before the closing slam.

harbinger-tyranny-void-orbs.spot: Several orbs sit on the floor for a short time.
harbinger-tyranny-void-orbs.avoid: They hit only if you walk on them. Path around the patches.

harbinger-tyranny-void-portal-blast.spot: A gate opens beside him. After a short timer he thrusts the hammer through it.
harbinger-tyranny-void-portal-blast.avoid: Leave the space in front of that gate before the delayed thrust.

harbinger-tyranny-void-rush.spot: He rushes toward you and strikes the space in front of him.
harbinger-tyranny-void-rush.avoid: Sidestep the path of the rush so the front hit misses.

harbinger-tyranny-void-strike.spot: He swings forward and sends a short wave.
harbinger-tyranny-void-strike.avoid: A side step takes you off that narrow wave.

harbinger-tyranny-void-turrets.spot: Orbs on the floor shoot one direction for several seconds.
harbinger-tyranny-void-turrets.avoid: Stand off the line each orb is firing.

harbinger-tyranny-frost-beam.spot: He fires a cold beam that also freezes.
harbinger-tyranny-frost-beam.avoid: Leave the beam. Freeze stops you acting, which is the dangerous part.

harbinger-tyranny-blizzard.spot: A large swirl forms around him and gets worse each second. He does not walk out of it.
harbinger-tyranny-blizzard.avoid: Only the space near him is safe. His slams are harder to avoid that close.

harbinger-ash-slam.spot: The first hit is small. A follow-up ring moves outward from the boss.
harbinger-ash-slam.avoid: Leave that small patch before the outward ring reaches you.

harbinger-ash-massive-slam.spot: The marked area for this slam is large.
harbinger-ash-massive-slam.avoid: Give the broad floor hit a full step of room.

harbinger-ash-echo-slam.spot: Five echoes join his slam on one shared point, then damage runs outward.
harbinger-ash-echo-slam.avoid: The shared middle is where several hits stack. Stand off that point.

harbinger-ash-void-combo-strike.spot: He slashes three times, then brings the weapon down.
harbinger-ash-void-combo-strike.avoid: The last slam is the hard hit. Step out before it lands.

harbinger-ash-void-orbs.spot: Orbs appear underfoot and linger briefly.
harbinger-ash-void-orbs.avoid: Route past each orb until it fades.

harbinger-ash-void-portal-blast.spot: The portal shows up next to him, then the hammer comes through.
harbinger-ash-void-portal-blast.avoid: Use the pause after the gate appears to step off its line.

harbinger-ash-void-rush.spot: The charge ends in a swing ahead of his body.
harbinger-ash-void-rush.avoid: Be beside the rush, not on the line he is running.

harbinger-ash-void-strike.spot: The wave is small and travels straight out from him.
harbinger-ash-void-strike.avoid: Do not stand on the short wave he sends ahead.

harbinger-ash-void-turrets.spot: Each placed orb fires a single way until it stops.
harbinger-ash-void-turrets.avoid: Step to either side of that shot.

harbinger-ash-necrotic-pool.spot: A large necrotic pool covers a lot of floor.
harbinger-ash-necrotic-pool.avoid: The pools leave little room. Plan a path before he stacks more skills on them.

harbinger-ash-necrotic-blast.spot: A medium circle appears, then a ball hits its center.
harbinger-ash-necrotic-blast.avoid: Leave the circle before the ball lands.

harbinger-ash-circling-fireballs.spot: One fireball circles him and gets larger the farther it travels.
harbinger-ash-circling-fireballs.avoid: Keep room to outrun it. If you wait, it is at full size when it reaches you.

abomination-invulnerability.spot: He cannot be damaged until four soul vessels in the corners are destroyed. The vessels also drop necrotic pools.
abomination-invulnerability.avoid: Kill the vessels in a circle, clockwise or the other way, so the pools are easier to leave.

abomination-tail-flair.spot: A red circle shows on the tail, then two lines, one in front of him and one behind. The front line aims at you.
abomination-tail-flair.avoid: Move away and to one side so you clear the circle and both lines.

abomination-necrotic-wave.spot: Three blue waves fire in a cone, then return. The return hits harder and can overlap.
abomination-necrotic-wave.avoid: Stand between two waves at range, or get behind him before they come back.

abomination-earthquake.spot: A tremor runs to where you were standing, then a small quake erupts there. Below 90 percent health it also casts Spirit Decay.
abomination-earthquake.avoid: Keep moving so the eruption is not under you.

abomination-spirit-decay.spot: From 90 percent health, four necrotic circles slowly chase you and grow stronger the longer they live.
abomination-spirit-decay.avoid: Do not let the chasing circles sit on you.

abomination-soul-reave.spot: He cleaves the space in front of him for a low necrotic hit.
abomination-soul-reave.avoid: The cleave is a light hit if your defenses are in place.

volcanic-shaman-lava-plume.spot: Three fire blasts step outward from the shaman. Each one farther out is larger.
volcanic-shaman-lava-plume.avoid: The third and farthest blast is the one to leave. It is the heavy hit in the set.

volcanic-shaman-torch-flame.spot: He channels fire on an area for several seconds, and the hit rises over that channel.
volcanic-shaman-torch-flame.avoid: Get off the channeled patch. It is one of the three heavy attacks.

volcanic-shaman-eruption.spot: The ground under him explodes in an X.
volcanic-shaman-eruption.avoid: Step off the X under his feet.

volcanic-shaman-magma-ball.spot: A magma ball travels forward and explodes on contact.
volcanic-shaman-magma-ball.avoid: Do not stand in the ball's path. It is one of the heavy fire hits.

volcanic-shaman-dragon-strike.spot: A dragon head strikes the space directly in front of him.
volcanic-shaman-dragon-strike.avoid: The front strike is a low hit. A side step still keeps you off it.

volcanic-shaman-spirit-form.spot: When a shaman dies he turns into a spirit, keeps a wide necrotic ring until the last shaman falls, and shoots necrotic bolts.
volcanic-shaman-spirit-form.avoid: Try to kill the shamans together so the spirit circles do not stack.

emperor-of-corpses-soul-bomb.spot: He rears onto his hind legs, then a very large circle explodes. Afterward the outside of the circle is a growing damage over time.
emperor-of-corpses-soul-bomb.avoid: Leave the circle before it explodes, far enough not to clip the edge, then run back in. Keep him near the center so you have room.

emperor-of-corpses-roar.spot: At 70 percent health he roars, slows you, and summons five slaughtered thralls.
emperor-of-corpses-roar.avoid: The roar is a light hit by itself. A roar just before Soul Bomb makes the explosion much harder to leave.

emperor-of-corpses-flesh-impact.spot: He shakes and fires body pieces that explode and spawn a thrall.
emperor-of-corpses-flesh-impact.avoid: Avoid taking several of the exploding pieces in a short time.

emperor-of-corpses-spirit-breath.spot: He raises his head, then breathes a necrotic cone that grows stronger. More than a second in it is a heavy hit.
emperor-of-corpses-spirit-breath.avoid: When the head goes up, move to his side or his back.

emperor-of-corpses-blood-pools.spot: Pools form on the arena edges and take a large percent of current health each second. They have no damage type and cannot finish you alone.
emperor-of-corpses-blood-pools.avoid: Stay central. When Soul Bomb fires, run to the bottom edge, where pools do not form.

emperor-of-corpses-melee-attack.spot: A front-leg swipe hits players in melee range.
emperor-of-corpses-melee-attack.avoid: The swipe is a low hit and can be taken if you are in melee.

frost-lich-formosus-teleport.spot: He teleports anywhere in the arena, often off screen. The teleport itself does no damage.
frost-lich-formosus-teleport.avoid: Be ready to look for him after he vanishes.

frost-lich-formosus-ice-patch.spot: A large ice patch on the ground slows you. It does no damage.
frost-lich-formosus-ice-patch.avoid: Do not fight the beam while you are stuck on the ice if you can step off it first.

frost-lich-formosus-undead-wengari.spot: Three axe throwers use a low physical shot. The matriarch's leap quake is mostly lightning and is the dangerous add.
frost-lich-formosus-undead-wengari.avoid: Kill the axe throwers and the matriarch so he can resurrect only one of them.

frost-lich-formosus-resurrect-wengari.spot: He brings back one slain wengari.
frost-lich-formosus-resurrect-wengari.avoid: Expect one add to return. Killing both kinds still limits which one comes back.

frost-lich-formosus-spirit-beam.spot: He channels a large beam in front that grows over several seconds.
frost-lich-formosus-spirit-beam.avoid: The beam is easy to leave unless an ice patch is slowing you. A movement skill helps when they overlap.

frost-lich-formosus-frost-spirit.spot: Seeking shots deal a low cold and necrotic hit.
frost-lich-formosus-frost-spirit.avoid: They are hard to dodge because they home. Take the light hit and watch the other mechanics.

frost-lich-formosus-ice-vortex.spot: Cold tornadoes drift slowly and grow stronger the longer they last.
frost-lich-formosus-ice-vortex.avoid: Track where they are and stay out. A fresh one on you is still weak for a moment, so move.

god-hunter-argentus-turrets.spot: Three turrets outside the arena follow you briefly, then lock a location. No damage type is stated.
god-hunter-argentus-turrets.avoid: Strafe from the moment the telegraph starts until they lock.

god-hunter-argentus-melee.avoid: It is a low physical hit and can be taken.

god-hunter-argentus-ice-stab.spot: He stabs a line in front of him and can apply frostbite.
god-hunter-argentus-ice-stab.avoid: Strafe as soon as the line shows. It is fast, so cold resistance still matters.

god-hunter-argentus-fire-bomb.spot: Circles spiral out from him and explode as they go.
god-hunter-argentus-fire-bomb.avoid: Step onto him when the spiral starts. The blasts travel outward.

god-hunter-argentus-ice-nova.spot: He channels a circle around himself that chills and applies frostbite.
god-hunter-argentus-ice-nova.avoid: Leave the circle as soon as it shows. You have a short gap before the channel.

god-hunter-argentus-flame-dash.avoid: The charge is a low hit and can be taken.

god-hunter-argentus-flame-leap.spot: In phase 3 he leaps and crashes down in a circle, plus three flares going out. The flares hit harder than the circle.
god-hunter-argentus-flame-leap.avoid: Run outside the circle and stand between the flares.

god-hunter-argentus-minions.spot: In phase 2, lightmages drop fire meteors marked by circles of light, and overlapping meteors are the danger while vanguards and raiders are not.
god-hunter-argentus-minions.avoid: Kill lightmages first and leave every circle of light.

hartons-husk-oblivion-spike.spot: Two lines fire out in front of him and deal void damage over time that rises each second.
hartons-husk-oblivion-spike.avoid: Move out of the lines early. Waiting makes them painful.

hartons-husk-abyssal-sundering.spot: From 65 percent health, extra spikes join Oblivion Spike. They start low and grow.
hartons-husk-abyssal-sundering.avoid: Treat the added spikes like the main lines and leave them before they ramp.

hartons-husk-idols-of-ruin.spot: Two worms last the fight with nearly Harton's health. Bite is light physical, Death Seeker is a void line, and Barrage of Ruin is ramping void damage.
hartons-husk-idols-of-ruin.avoid: Leave Barrage of Ruin as it ramps. Do not spend the fight killing the idols.

hartons-husk-claw-slam.spot: He slams the ground in front of him.
hartons-husk-claw-slam.avoid: Step off the front slam. It is a moderate physical hit.

hartons-husk-corrupted-slash.spot: A melee swing covers the space in front of him.
hartons-husk-corrupted-slash.avoid: The swing is a low hit. Sidestep if you are in front of him.

hartons-husk-void-stab.spot: A stab in front of him with a circular hit.
hartons-husk-void-stab.avoid: Leave the circle on the stab. It is a moderate void hit.

heorot-monolith-frost-beam.spot: A cold beam also freezes, and the damage rises while it fires.
heorot-monolith-frost-beam.avoid: Leave the beam. Freeze stops your actions.

heorot-monolith-frosted-eruption-frozen-.spot: He places pillars, and above 75 percent health a frozen orb then fires shrapnel.
heorot-monolith-frosted-eruption-frozen-.avoid: Hide behind a pillar for the opening quarter so the shrapnel is blocked, and below 75 percent health he drops the orb.

heorot-monolith-ice-stab.spot: A fast stab in front of him.
heorot-monolith-ice-stab.avoid: The stab is a moderate cold and physical hit. A quick side step clears the front.

heorot-monolith-ice-spear.spot: A spear shot at you, only when you are outside melee range.
heorot-monolith-ice-spear.avoid: The spear is a low cold hit. Closing to melee stops him using it.

heorot-monolith-ice-circle.spot: Three explosions ring him in a row. Each is larger, farther out, and harder.
heorot-monolith-ice-circle.avoid: The outer ring is the one to clear. The blasts step away from him.

heorot-monolith-charge.spot: He charges away from you and can leave the screen if he does not hit a wall. The charge itself does no damage.
heorot-monolith-charge.avoid: Try to aim him at a nearby wall, and keep a movement skill ready if the charge plus blizzard carries him off.

heorot-monolith-blizzard.spot: From 75 percent health a swirl surrounds him, shreds cold resistance, and worsens each second.
heorot-monolith-blizzard.avoid: Only the space near him is safe while the swirl is up.

heorot-monolith-jump-back.spot: He hops back a short distance. No damage is listed.
heorot-monolith-jump-back.avoid: The hop is dangerous mainly with blizzard, because it can put the safe pocket somewhere else.

heorot-monolith-ice-guard.spot: He seals himself at 55 percent and at 35. The first seal ends once Grael and the Spirit of Jormun die, and ice wolves keep spawning through the second seal.
heorot-monolith-ice-guard.avoid: Break the first guard by killing those two. On the second guard, deal with the wolves as they keep coming.

lagon-monolith-moon-beam.spot: He rises and shifts to one side of you. His eye glows red while he rises.
lagon-monolith-moon-beam.avoid: Once that eye is red, cross to the opposite side.

lagon-monolith-moon-shot.spot: Below 65 percent health he lowers his head and fires a quick beam forward.
lagon-monolith-moon-shot.avoid: The beam is only in front of the lowered head. Step off that line.

lagon-monolith-moon-blast.spot: He rises and puts a large circle on the ground under himself, then blasts it. The blast also slows.
lagon-monolith-moon-blast.avoid: Leave the big circle before the blast. It is clearly marked.

lagon-monolith-lightning-strikes.spot: Random lightning hits the arena. A circle shows a moment before each one.
lagon-monolith-lightning-strikes.avoid: Step off each circle. The hit itself is low.

lagon-monolith-melee-attacks.spot: Either claw hits the ground in front of him. The left claw, on your right, always stuns for 2 seconds.
lagon-monolith-melee-attacks.avoid: Avoid the claws, especially the one on your right, so the stun does not ruin a later dodge.

lagon-monolith-tentacles.spot: In phase 2 his tentacles use low physical attacks with a high stun chance.
lagon-monolith-tentacles.avoid: Kill the tentacles. Phase 3 does not start until they are dead.

lagon-monolith-adds.spot: Flayer sharks and crabs spawn through phase 2.
lagon-monolith-adds.avoid: Neither is a major threat alone. Do not let the sharks pile up.

lagon-monolith-cold-waves.spot: From phase 2, cold waves come often enough that dodging all of them is hard. In phase 3 they can be avoided near his end of the platform.
lagon-monolith-cold-waves.avoid: Stand close to his end of the platform and slightly off center. Dead center is still in the waves, and too far off center is in Moon Beam range.

rahyeh-the-black-sun-dive-bomb.spot: He launches, then crashes down after a short delay.
rahyeh-the-black-sun-dive-bomb.avoid: Run toward him. The edge of the crash is closest in that direction.

rahyeh-the-black-sun-void-blast.spot: He marks a large area in front, then hits it after a short delay. He needs melee range to use it.
rahyeh-the-black-sun-void-blast.avoid: Run toward him to reach the edge fastest. Stepping out of melee stops repeat casts until he uses something else.

rahyeh-the-black-sun-void-flares.spot: From the center he charges cones in a pie pattern.
rahyeh-the-black-sun-void-flares.avoid: Shift clockwise or the other way, or move back and forth between two cones.

rahyeh-the-black-sun-wave-dash.spot: He flies just outside the arena, then dashes through and leaves a high void trail for several seconds.
rahyeh-the-black-sun-wave-dash.avoid: Stand still until he dashes at you, then step to either side. Stay off the trail until it fades.

rahyeh-the-black-sun-void-skyfall.spot: Meteors fall over several seconds. Each one is a moderate void hit, and they can overlap.
rahyeh-the-black-sun-void-skyfall.avoid: Do not get stunned inside a meteor. Overlaps are the costly part.

rahyeh-the-black-sun-summon-adds.spot: Projectiles become voidform minions on the ground.
rahyeh-the-black-sun-summon-adds.avoid: The minions are low health and a low hit. Kill them quickly.

husk-of-elder-gaspar-tri-beam-fire.spot: When he teleports to the center, three beams rotate counterclockwise, one each of fire, cold, and lightning, and they rise while active.
husk-of-elder-gaspar-tri-beam-fire.avoid: Run counterclockwise with the beams. Boot movement speed is enough because the spin is slow.

husk-of-elder-gaspar-frozen-ice-storm.spot: Right after the beams, cold tornadoes spiral out in an alternating pattern.
husk-of-elder-gaspar-frozen-ice-storm.avoid: A sturdy build can take it. You can also shuffle side to side as he rotates the pattern.

husk-of-elder-gaspar-teleport-with-void-.spot: He teleports, then a small void explosion pops at the destination.
husk-of-elder-gaspar-teleport-with-void-.avoid: The arrival blast is a low hit. Do not be standing on the landing spot.

husk-of-elder-gaspar-summon-flaming-void.spot: Totems copy his high fire circle, drop in pairs from 60 percent health, and have little life.
husk-of-elder-gaspar-summon-flaming-void.avoid: Kill totems as they appear so they do not pile up. That matters more after 60 percent.

husk-of-elder-gaspar-spark-discharge.spot: Lightning balls explode when touched, after a short delay.
husk-of-elder-gaspar-spark-discharge.avoid: Touch them when nothing else is happening, then move. Speed or a movement skill clears the blast.

husk-of-elder-gaspar-doom-blast-with-voi.spot: Large marked explosions hit around the arena, then a whirlwind forms on the outskirts and grows.
husk-of-elder-gaspar-doom-blast-with-voi.avoid: Leave the marked blasts. Stand near the center until the edge whirlwind fades.

lagon-campaign-moon-beam.spot: He lifts off toward one side, and the eye turns red.
lagon-campaign-moon-beam.avoid: Hold until that eye is red, then cross to the opposite side.

lagon-campaign-moon-shot.spot: Below 65 percent health he lowers his head and fires a quick beam forward.
lagon-campaign-moon-shot.avoid: Step off the line in front of the lowered head.

lagon-campaign-moon-blast.spot: He lifts up, marks a wide ring beneath his body, and the blast also slows.
lagon-campaign-moon-blast.avoid: Leave the circle before the blast.

lagon-campaign-lightning-strikes.spot: Random strikes show a circle a moment beforehand.
lagon-campaign-lightning-strikes.avoid: Step off the circle. Each strike is a low hit.

lagon-campaign-melee-attacks.spot: A claw hits in front of him. The left claw, on your right, always stuns for 2 seconds.
lagon-campaign-melee-attacks.avoid: Avoid the melee, especially the claw on your right.

lagon-campaign-tentacles-phase.spot: Phase 2 tentacles use low physical attacks, and the stun is a high chance rather than a sure thing.

lagon-campaign-adds.spot: Flayer sharks and crabs spawn in phase 2. No damage type is stated.
lagon-campaign-adds.avoid: They are minor unless the sharks are allowed to accumulate.

lagon-campaign-cold-waves.spot: Cold waves from phase 2 come so often that dodging every one is unrealistic.
lagon-campaign-cold-waves.avoid: Cap cold resistance, because you will have to take some of them.

lagons-tentacle-tentacle-attack.spot: Phase 2 tentacles deal low physical hits and have a high stun chance.
lagons-tentacle-tentacle-attack.avoid: They have to die before phase 3 starts.

majasa-phase-1-stone-stare.spot: Both phases stack Stone Stare, and the fourth stack turns you to stone so you cannot act.
majasa-phase-1-stone-stare.avoid: Avoid the stare, and cleanse stacks you already have.

majasa-phase-1-siege-bolt.spot: A giant red area in phase 1 is called out as able to fell most builds on a critical hit, and no damage type is stated.

majasa-phase-1-fire-and-poison-bolt.spot: Poison or fire bolts are cast when you stand too far from her.
majasa-phase-1-fire-and-poison-bolt.avoid: Step sideways. Staying close stops the ranged bolts.

majasa-phase-1-stalactite-falling.spot: Falling stalactites leave a poison pool. The hit element is not stated.
majasa-phase-1-stalactite-falling.avoid: Stand at the top or the bottom of the arena, where the pools cannot spawn.

majasa-phase-1-stomp.spot: A big block with lightning sparks appears over your head, then lightning spikes launch at you.
majasa-phase-1-stomp.avoid: Move in a circle so both the landing and the spikes miss.

majasa-phase-1-adds.spot: At 66 and 33 percent health she goes underground and summons three essences, each with its own element.

majasa-phase-2-melee-attacks.spot: She chases and her melee applies armor shred. This phase is physical only.
majasa-phase-2-melee-attacks.avoid: The swings are hard to dodge. Bring armor and recovery instead of chasing every swing.

majasa-phase-2-tail-attack.spot: The tail swipe also applies armor shred.
majasa-phase-2-tail-attack.avoid: Do not spend effort dodging the tail. It is the same shred problem as her melee.

majasa-phase-2-corrupting-bomb.spot: Blood pools appear first, and she pulls them in to make the bomb. Those pools stack a lot of armor shred.
majasa-phase-2-corrupting-bomb.avoid: Never stand in the blood pools. Move away when she calls them back.

majasa-phase-2-regen.spot: At 50 percent health she runs to a closed sarcophagus and heals to full. She does this twice.
majasa-phase-2-regen.avoid: Hit her during the heal. After both sarcophagi are open, the heal stops.

aberroth-timeshattering-slam.spot: He casts Absorbing Chaos and charges 4.5 seconds, or 3 seconds in phase 5, then a growing circle of void and physical.
aberroth-timeshattering-slam.avoid: Deal damage during the charge, and move out before the circle goes off.

aberroth-persisting-void.spot: Orbs travel side to side. A hit leaves a pool that lasts until cleared.
aberroth-persisting-void.avoid: Dodge the orbs. A superheated black hole removes the pools.

aberroth-void-beam.spot: Beams aim at you for 2.5 seconds, then fire and apply Frailty of Aberroth. They stay between phases.
aberroth-void-beam.avoid: Lay the beams next to one another along the north and south so the last phase still has space.

aberroth-superheated-black-hole.spot: After 1.5 seconds a small fire hit lands on you and applies ignite.
aberroth-superheated-black-hole.avoid: Step off your spot, and use the black hole to clear Persisting Void pools.

aberroth-superchilled-black-hole.spot: It lands on you for a moderate cold hit and pulls in cold shots that apply chill.
aberroth-superchilled-black-hole.avoid: Leave the landing spot so the hole and the pulled shots are not on you.

aberroth-triple-flail-slam.spot: Three triangles slam one by one. He hits the middle first, then his right and his left.
aberroth-triple-flail-slam.avoid: The safe spot is behind him. Or stand left or right, then step into the middle after the first slam.

aberroth-slam-ground-of-destruction.spot: A slam of physical and void leaves Ground of Destruction in the same direction, a high void damage over time.
aberroth-slam-ground-of-destruction.avoid: Leave the slam and do not stand on the ground effect it leaves along that line.

aberroth-called-meteors.spot: He stands still and calls meteors toward himself for 3 seconds. They are high fire and apply ignite.
aberroth-called-meteors.avoid: When the channel starts, move to his side or behind him.

aberroth-lobbed-meteors.spot: Medium-range meteors deal high cold damage and apply frostbite.
aberroth-lobbed-meteors.avoid: Step off the meteor marks before they land.

aberroth-roots.spot: Roots hold you in place for a short time.
aberroth-roots.avoid: Use a movement skill or a cleanse to get out.

aberroth-blade-of-chaos.spot: A blade travels in a wide arc from him, hitting with physical, lightning, and void.

aberroth-cursing-scythe.spot: Four necrotic bolts apply Curse of Aberroth, which cuts all resistances and cannot be cleansed.
aberroth-cursing-scythe.avoid: Do not get hit by the bolts.

aberroth-cosmic-absorption-lazer-of-deat.spot: Cosmic Absorption charges for 2.5 seconds, then Lazer of Death is a massive void hit.
aberroth-cosmic-absorption-lazer-of-deat.avoid: Leave the charge zone, then step off the Lazer of Death.

aberroth-phase-3-quadrant-ground-effects.spot: Four quadrants: quicksand applies Frailty of Aberroth, lightning applies Shock of Aberroth, winds apply Chill of Aberroth, and fiery ground is a small fire hit.
aberroth-phase-3-quadrant-ground-effects.avoid: Fiery ground is usually the safer quadrant if your recovery can handle the small fire hit.

aberroth-regular-attacks-melee-attack-ch.spot: His regular kit is a melee swing, a charge, a flail dash, and a backward hop.
aberroth-regular-attacks-melee-attack-ch.avoid: Treat these as his basic swings and step off the one that is aimed at you.

herald-of-oblivion-timeshattering-slam.spot: Absorbing Chaos charges for 4.5 seconds, or 3 in phase 5, before a growing void and physical circle.
herald-of-oblivion-timeshattering-slam.avoid: Use the charge to deal damage, then leave before the slam releases.

herald-of-oblivion-persisting-void.spot: Side-to-side orbs leave a lasting void pool on hit.
herald-of-oblivion-persisting-void.avoid: Miss the orbs. Superheated Black Hole is what deletes the pools.

herald-of-oblivion-void-beam.spot: A beam tracks you for 2.5 seconds, fires, and applies Frailty of Aberroth. Beams persist across phases.
herald-of-oblivion-void-beam.avoid: Set beams beside each other on the north and south edges.

herald-of-oblivion-superheated-black-hol.spot: A small fire hit with ignite drops on your location after 1.5 seconds.
herald-of-oblivion-superheated-black-hol.avoid: Move, and drop it on Persisting Void when you want those pools gone.

herald-of-oblivion-superchilled-black-ho.spot: A moderate cold hole on you also pulls chill projectiles.
herald-of-oblivion-superchilled-black-ho.avoid: Do not stand on the hole or in the shots it gathers.

herald-of-oblivion-triple-flail-slam.spot: Triangles slam middle first, then the boss's right and left, for void and lightning.
herald-of-oblivion-triple-flail-slam.avoid: Stand behind him. The other dodge is left or right, then into the middle after the first slam.

herald-of-oblivion-slam-ground-of-destru.spot: The slam leaves a void damage-over-time strip in the same direction.
herald-of-oblivion-slam-ground-of-destru.avoid: Exit the slam and stay off the strip it paints.

herald-of-oblivion-called-meteors.spot: He channels in place for 3 seconds while fire meteors come toward him and apply ignite.
herald-of-oblivion-called-meteors.avoid: Move beside or behind him once the channel begins.

herald-of-oblivion-lobbed-meteors.spot: Lobbed cold meteors apply frostbite at medium range.

herald-of-oblivion-roots.spot: You are locked in place briefly.
herald-of-oblivion-roots.avoid: A movement skill or a cleanse breaks the lock.

herald-of-oblivion-blade-of-chaos.spot: A wide arc of physical, lightning, and void comes off his position.
herald-of-oblivion-blade-of-chaos.avoid: Step out of the arc as it travels.

herald-of-oblivion-cursing-scythe.spot: Four necrotic bolts apply a curse that lowers every resistance and cannot be cleansed.

herald-of-oblivion-cosmic-absorption-laz.spot: A 2.5 second charge becomes a massive void lazer.
herald-of-oblivion-cosmic-absorption-laz.avoid: Clear the charge zone, then sidestep the beam.

herald-of-oblivion-phase-3-quadrant-grou.spot: Quicksand, lightning, winds, and fiery ground split the floor. They apply frailty, shock, and chill of Aberroth, except fiery ground which is a small fire hit.
herald-of-oblivion-phase-3-quadrant-grou.avoid: Prefer fiery ground when your recovery covers that small hit.

herald-of-oblivion-regular-attacks-melee.spot: Melee, charge, flail dash, and a backward hop are the basic attacks.
herald-of-oblivion-regular-attacks-melee.avoid: Sidestep whichever of those four is coming at you.

vision-of-the-observer-void-rift.spot: Segments appear one after another and always in a clockwise pattern, for a very high void hit.
vision-of-the-observer-void-rift.avoid: Move with the clockwise order so you are not on the next segment.

vision-of-the-observer-persisting-void.spot: Orbs move toward you and leave a pool. The damage type follows the active omen.
vision-of-the-observer-persisting-void.avoid: Overlap the pools so the floor does not fill up.

vision-of-the-observer-void-meteor.spot: A shadowy line shows before each meteor. Three of them sweep for high void and physical.
vision-of-the-observer-void-meteor.avoid: Leave the shadowy line before the meteor arrives.

vision-of-the-observer-void-reform.spot: It teleports onto you and deals a moderate void hit.
vision-of-the-observer-void-reform.avoid: Move out of the area at the end of the cast.

vision-of-the-observer-teleport.spot: It teleports around the arena several times. No hit is stated for the blinks themselves.
vision-of-the-observer-teleport.avoid: Track where it reappears rather than swinging at the old spot.

vision-of-the-observer-void-beam.spot: Three beams from its body deal moderate void damage over time.
vision-of-the-observer-void-beam.avoid: Step out of the three beams.

vision-of-the-observer-frozen-ice-storm.spot: A cold projectile moves slowly and expands.
vision-of-the-observer-frozen-ice-storm.avoid: Walk off its path. It is slow, so you have time.

vision-of-the-observer-orbiting-comet.spot: Projectiles orbit the outer edge for a high cold hit.
vision-of-the-observer-orbiting-comet.avoid: Do not stand on the outer ring while the comets are circling.

vision-of-the-observer-flamethrower.spot: A cone of moderate fire comes off its location.

vision-of-the-observer-starburst.spot: A circle sits, then explodes for high fire damage.
vision-of-the-observer-starburst.avoid: Leave the circle before the duration ends.

vision-of-the-observer-falling-meteor.spot: Three meteors rest on the ground in the final phase and deal extremely high physical and void damage.

vision-of-the-observer-ground-of-destruc.spot: Final phase only, floor lines deal a small void damage over time and linger.
vision-of-the-observer-ground-of-destruc.avoid: Stay off the lines until they disappear.

vision-of-the-observer-absorbing-meteors.spot: Three meteors fall in a repeating sequence for a low void hit, final phase only.
vision-of-the-observer-absorbing-meteors.avoid: Keep moving between the falling marks so the repeats do not land on you.

julra-catastrophic-implosion.spot: A huge clock runs. At 12 o'clock the whole screen takes void damage and 4 Doom stacks.
julra-catastrophic-implosion.avoid: Use Temporal Shift before 12 o'clock. If you are caught, cleanse the Doom stacks.

julra-dimension-tear.spot: A few seconds after she changes timeline, a circle forms at your feet, follows you while it forms, then sits and deals high void damage over time.
julra-dimension-tear.avoid: Walk the forming puddle to the edge of the room, then run out. A timed Temporal Shift can also skip it into the implosion window.

julra-summon-pillars-lightning-bolt.spot: Three pillars exist in both eras. Divine ones can be broken and never shoot, while Ruined ones are immune and fire a marked lightning bolt that shocks.
julra-summon-pillars-lightning-bolt.avoid: Kill them in the Divine era. In the Ruined era, dodge the bolts until you shift eras.

julra-summon-healing-fountain.spot: A fountain heals her with fast projectiles and can be destroyed.
julra-summon-healing-fountain.avoid: Break fountains quickly, but do not stand in another attack to do it.

julra-frigid-tide.spot: A cone toward you deals a moderate cold hit and chills.

julra-unraveling-decay.spot: Four beams spin clockwise from the middle, a gap stays open near the middle, and the hits are high void plus void resistance shred.
julra-unraveling-decay.avoid: Stand in a gap near the center. Save potions if you are melee and she stands in her own beams, because leech stops.

julra-temporal-shot.avoid: Keep moving. This shot and the pillar bolts come too fast to time one by one.

julra-chilled-seeker.avoid: The seekers follow, so use a movement skill to break their line rather than backing up in a straight path.

julra-shocking-impact.spot: A mortar explodes in a circle, with a small version and a larger harder one, and both are lightning.
julra-shocking-impact.avoid: Leave the circle on the ground. The bigger mark is the harder hit.

mountain-beneath-burn-kindling-pyres.spot: Root walls block the left and right pyres, Burning Amber lights a pyre, and both must burn before phase 2.
mountain-beneath-burn-kindling-pyres.avoid: Light the far right pyre first, then recall to the left one the moment that right pyre catches.

mountain-beneath-rock-fall.spot: Many rocks fall, each a moderate physical circle at the impact.

mountain-beneath-rock-fall-with-summons.spot: One rock falls, deals a moderate physical circle, and summons a titanspawn or three mountain roots.
mountain-beneath-rock-fall-with-summons.avoid: Kill the titanspawn and roots while you wait for the first shockwave.

mountain-beneath-shockwave.spot: He slams twice for a very high physical hit. The left side of the arena is always first.
mountain-beneath-shockwave.avoid: Start center-right so the first slam misses, then move to the left side for the second.

mountain-beneath-entangling-roots-mounta.spot: A wall of roots crosses from the right toward the left and briefly holds you with a low physical hit.
mountain-beneath-entangling-roots-mounta.avoid: Do not stand in the wall as it crosses. It holds you if it connects.

stone-titans-heart-rockfall-stone-titan-.spot: Rocks fall in moderate physical circles.

stone-titans-heart-summon-titanflesh.spot: Four titanflesh use a low physical melee.
stone-titans-heart-summon-titanflesh.avoid: They are not very threatening. Clear them when you can so the hits do not stack.

stone-titans-heart-spore-beam.spot: A beam splits and the halves move opposite ways. It reaches farther on higher tiers, for very high physical and poison.
stone-titans-heart-spore-beam.avoid: As soon as you see the beam, go to the opposite side. It does not cover the whole arena, but higher tiers cover most of it.

stone-titans-heart-energy-stone.spot: A large stone circles the heart, starting close and moving outward.
stone-titans-heart-energy-stone.avoid: The stone is a low physical hit. Step off its circle as it expands.

stone-titans-heart-energy-wave.spot: One quadrant is targeted. The wave there is low physical and applies 4 poison stacks.
stone-titans-heart-energy-wave.avoid: Cleanse the poison or leave the quadrant. Sometimes that safe side overlaps the spore beam, and only a movement skill or high move speed clears both.

stone-titans-heart-entangling-roots-ston.spot: Roots cover the arena and immobilize, a low physical hit.
stone-titans-heart-entangling-roots-ston.avoid: The safe place is the area closest to the heart.

stone-titans-heart-frenzied-thorns.spot: Several thorns fire toward you. Each applies multiple poison stacks.
stone-titans-heart-frenzied-thorns.avoid: Sidestep the thorns, or cleanse the poison if a thorn connects.

stone-titans-heart-oblivion.spot: Mines sit on the ground and their area grows until they explode.
stone-titans-heart-oblivion.avoid: Leave a mine before its growing area reaches you.

fire-lich-cremorus-fire-necrotic-floor.spot: Floor sections turn on as you deal damage, high necrotic damage over time, until the whole floor is active. Then it switches between necrotic and fire.
fire-lich-cremorus-fire-necrotic-floor.avoid: Once the whole floor is covered, be ready to switch immunities quickly.

fire-lich-cremorus-flaming-necrotic-orbi.spot: Two kinds of skulls orbit him, one moderate necrotic and one moderate fire.
fire-lich-cremorus-flaming-necrotic-orbi.avoid: Do not stand in the orbit path of either skull.

fire-lich-cremorus-chaotic-soul.spot: A large skull chases you for a low fire and necrotic hit.
fire-lich-cremorus-chaotic-soul.avoid: Kite the chasing skull so it is not on you during a floor swap.

fire-lich-cremorus-incendiary-torrent.spot: He channels a fire line at where you stood when the channel started. It rises every second and applies ignite often.
fire-lich-cremorus-incendiary-torrent.avoid: Leave that line. Even if you are fire immune, the ignites can kill you during a ground transition.

fire-lich-cremorus-wall-of-fire.spot: A fire wall crosses the arena for a moderate fire hit.
fire-lich-cremorus-wall-of-fire.avoid: A movement skill with an invulnerability frame crosses the wall. Teleport, Shift with Shadowslip, Transplant, or Lunge with Unstoppable and Paranoia are the examples given.

fire-lich-cremorus-raging-vengeful-soul.spot: Skulls alternate fire and necrotic, fire ones apply ignite, necrotic ones apply Marked for Death, and both are moderate to high.
fire-lich-cremorus-raging-vengeful-soul.avoid: Dodge the skull stream. Marked for Death from the necrotic skulls raises later hits.

fire-lich-cremorus-summon-thrall-golem-b.spot: A thrall chases you, then bursts for high necrotic damage and Marked for Death.
fire-lich-cremorus-summon-thrall-golem-b.avoid: Run from the thrall until it explodes behind you.

fire-lich-cremorus-disintegration.spot: A pair of shots each cover a wide necrotic circle and also apply Marked for Death.
fire-lich-cremorus-disintegration.avoid: Leave both circles. Marked for Death raises the damage of everything else.

fire-lich-cremorus-collapsing-decay.spot: A necrotic circle collapses into him for a moderate hit. It cannot be dodged by walking.
fire-lich-cremorus-collapsing-decay.avoid: Cross it with a movement skill that has an invulnerability frame, the same list as the fire wall.

fire-lich-cremorus-summon-skeletons.spot: Eight imperial guards use melee for a low physical hit.
fire-lich-cremorus-summon-skeletons.avoid: The guards are a low hit. Clear them when the floor lets you.

shade-of-orobyss-flamethrower.spot: A ball of fire forms in front of him, then a cone fires the way he was facing.
shade-of-orobyss-flamethrower.avoid: The cone is a moderate hit and can be taken.

shade-of-orobyss-starburst.spot: Three fire balls sit in random spots with a dark circle, then burst for high fire inside the circle.
shade-of-orobyss-starburst.avoid: The circles are hard to see and can overlap. Find them and move away until they explode.

shade-of-orobyss-lightning-bolt.spot: He channels briefly, then fires one bolt forward.
shade-of-orobyss-lightning-bolt.avoid: The bolt is a moderate lightning hit and can be taken.

shade-of-orobyss-spark.spot: After a channel, four lightning balls travel at random, shred lightning resistance, and grow stronger. Several can hit in a row.
shade-of-orobyss-spark.avoid: When the sparks appear, find a spot away from them. They are only light at the start.

shade-of-orobyss-orbiting-comet.spot: Cold projectiles circle him at several distances and grow stronger. They do not enter melee range.
shade-of-orobyss-orbiting-comet.avoid: Stand in melee range. If you leave to dodge something else, get back in quickly.

shade-of-orobyss-frozen-ice-storm.spot: A slow cold projectile moves in a straight line, grows, and hits harder over its life.
shade-of-orobyss-frozen-ice-storm.avoid: Move off its line as soon as he fires it.

shade-of-orobyss-blood-effigy.spot: A copy stands in the center of the ring, does not move, and deals rising physical damage until killed.
shade-of-orobyss-blood-effigy.avoid: The damage cannot be dodged and ramps. Kill the effigy immediately.

shade-of-orobyss-blood-orb.spot: Three orbs chase and explode for a high physical hit. They despawn if they never reach you.
shade-of-orobyss-blood-orb.avoid: Dodge them until they expire, or break one at a time so the hits stay small.

shade-of-orobyss-poison-puke.spot: He rears back and fires a cone of high poison that grows and applies poison.
shade-of-orobyss-poison-puke.avoid: Strafe around a poison shade the whole fight so this cone is not dropped on you.

shade-of-orobyss-toxic-spread.spot: Poison pools appear in a line in front of him and grow over the skill.
shade-of-orobyss-toxic-spread.avoid: Keep strafing so the line of pools is not placed on you.

shade-of-orobyss-concentrated-burst.spot: Cones from his body explode after a short wait for very high void, and they shrink the usable arena.
shade-of-orobyss-concentrated-burst.avoid: Leave the cones. Keep a patch of floor that is also safe from his other skills.

shade-of-orobyss-circle-of-death.spot: Large circles explode in quick succession for moderate void. The farthest from him appears first and the closest last.
shade-of-orobyss-circle-of-death.avoid: Start moving off the far circle, then keep moving as the closer ones appear.

shade-of-orobyss-bursting-void.spot: A large circle at your feet explodes quickly for moderate void.
shade-of-orobyss-bursting-void.avoid: Step off your feet as soon as the circle shows.

shade-of-orobyss-crystal-crush.spot: A large crystal appears over his head and slams down in front of him.
shade-of-orobyss-crystal-crush.avoid: The slam is in front of him. Step aside of that drop.

shade-of-orobyss-black-hole-decay.spot: Three lines of black holes project outward and grow stronger over their duration.
shade-of-orobyss-black-hole-decay.avoid: It is a fast kill if you stand in a hole, and the lines are easy to leave.

shade-of-orobyss-absorbing-meteors.spot: He turns into a black hole and drags meteors in from off screen, each a moderate void hit, and standing closer is riskier.
shade-of-orobyss-absorbing-meteors.avoid: Stop attacking and give yourself room to move around the meteors.

shade-of-orobyss-mini-black-holes.spot: Small black holes drift in and explode a moment after they touch you, for moderate void.
shade-of-orobyss-mini-black-holes.avoid: Run through a few without stopping so they explode behind you. Repeat until they are gone.

shade-of-orobyss-melee-attack.spot: A melee swipe of low physical and void. He always has this, whatever else he rolled.
shade-of-orobyss-melee-attack.avoid: The swipe is a low hit in melee range.

shade-of-orobyss-falling-meteor.spot: A very large meteor forms in front of him and falls slowly. The void hit rises over the fall.
shade-of-orobyss-falling-meteor.avoid: Move out of it and stay out until it expires.

shade-of-orobyss-exploding-black-hole.spot: Three black holes grow in random spots for high void. When one expires it explodes into a star of low void shots.
shade-of-orobyss-exploding-black-hole.avoid: Only the black hole is dangerous, and the star shots that follow are a very small hit.

shade-of-orobyss-void-rift.spot: A void ball fires at you, then a rift sends it back into the arena for a second pass.
shade-of-orobyss-void-rift.avoid: When he fires, find the rift and strafe around it at a distance so the return shot misses.

shade-of-orobyss-void-meteor.spot: He shouts The end comes, then a very large meteor crosses the arena on a shown path, and the direction is random.
shade-of-orobyss-void-meteor.avoid: On The end comes, leave the telegraph. Use a movement skill if you need the distance.

shade-of-orobyss-summon-tentacles.spot: Three tentacles use a line melee of moderate physical and void with a high stun chance. They can be killed.
shade-of-orobyss-summon-tentacles.avoid: Kill the tentacles so they do not stack with his other skills.

shade-of-orobyss-summon-eyes.spot: Five eyes fire a moderate void beam at you at the same time. They can be killed.
shade-of-orobyss-summon-eyes.avoid: Kill the eyes before the beams stack with everything else.

shade-of-orobyss-piercing-void.spot: A fast projectile for a low void hit.
shade-of-orobyss-piercing-void.avoid: The shot is low. A side step still takes you off it.

shade-of-orobyss-dark-warp.spot: He warps from where he is to a spot near you. No hit is stated for the warp.
shade-of-orobyss-dark-warp.avoid: Expect him to appear beside you and be ready for the next swing.

shade-of-orobyss-oblivion-leap.spot: He leaps to where you are and slams for moderate physical and void. A telegraph shows it.
shade-of-orobyss-oblivion-leap.avoid: Leave the landing mark. The telegraph is readable.

shade-of-orobyss-oblivion-dash.spot: He runs at you at high speed. A collision is a low void hit.

shade-of-orobyss-void-reform.spot: He bursts where he stands and reforms on you with a second burst, both moderate void, and a telegraph shows the spots.
shade-of-orobyss-void-reform.avoid: Leave both the start and your own spot before the explosions.

shade-of-orobyss-void-rush.spot: He walks toward you behind a large void barrier that deals moderate void. A telegraph shows it.
